# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes target the current 1.x release line and the default branch.
Older releases may remain useful for format compatibility but are not
maintained as security branches.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for
[unicbm/demotracer](https://github.com/unicbm/demotracer/security/advisories/new).
Do not publish exploit details, signing material, private server data, or a
working proof of concept in a public issue.

Include the affected version or commit, component, reproduction conditions,
impact, and the smallest safe evidence needed to verify the report. If private
reporting is unavailable, open a public issue requesting a private contact
channel without disclosing vulnerability details.
